per_unit_disposition.notes: zero-base-challenge.json states 8 concrete assumptions (A-WAVE-SHAPE, A-SINGLE-INTEGRATOR, A-GIT-SINK, A-HASHED-JSONL, A-CRITERIA-BEHAVIOUR, A-MODEL-MATCH, A-SOURCE-CAPSULE-CLOSURE, A-DISJOINT-WRITER-PREFIXES), each with a real path/artifact citation (not a general appeal) and an explicit per-assumption verdict (UPHELD / UNDERMINED / NOT_YET_SUPPORTED, which this reviewer reads as satisfying the frozen pass_bar's 'upheld/flagged' requirement in spirit: everything not UPHELD is treated as a non-binding flag). This reviewer independently spot-checked the A-SOURCE-CAPSULE-CLOSURE evidence citation (path-ownership.json observed_sha256) against the real git blob at a9's own pinned snapshot commit and it matched exactly (test_zero_base_evidence_citation_for_path_ownership_drift_is_accurate). No proposal is treated as binding: every proposal object carries binding_state=PROPOSAL_ONLY, applied_to_active_wave=false, and the artifact's top-level decision_changed=[] is honored throughout -- no reject_trigger observed.
per_unit_disposition.additional_finding: A-SOURCE-CAPSULE-CLOSURE is not just accurate but understated: this reviewer found path-ownership.json has drifted a THIRD time since a9 measured it (dispatch-frozen 73f1fb8... -> a9-observed 27deb460... -> current a9-branch-head eb2d602c...), independently strengthening a9's own finding beyond what a9 itself measured. This also affects this reviewer's own a10-u04 dispatch source_hashes, which were frozen against the same pre-drift value a9 cites -- a real, self-referential confirmation, not a hypothetical.

per_unit_disposition.notes: Four topologies (T1-CENTRAL-SERIAL, T2-COHORT-SHARDS, T3-OPTIMISTIC-PEERS, T4-CONTENT-FANIN) are specified with enough concreteness (verification_writers, final_promotion_authorities, mutable_coordination_surfaces, scheduling, collision_rule, recovery_rule, batch_size) that this reviewer independently reimplemented the comparison's expected shape from the description alone before even opening topology_sim.py. The comparison uses real Wave A data: wave-a-spec.json's declared_units=74 and cohort_counts are read directly from the actual committed file, and its cited sha256 (3652f17f...) matches this reviewer's own independently computed hash of that file. This reviewer re-ran topology_sim.py itself (not a9's output) from an isolated clone against the real committed wave-a-spec.json and the freshly generated topology-candidates.json/topology-comparison.json are byte-for-byte identical to a9's committed artifacts, including the exact throughput ratio (3.545454) and winning topology (T4-CONTENT-FANIN). No fail_trigger observed.
per_unit_disposition.limitation: Like a9's own comparison.limitation field states, this is a deterministic operation-count simulation, not production latency; this reviewer's re-execution establishes reproducibility and real-data grounding, not production validity, which a9 never claimed either.

per_unit_disposition.notes: source_capsule.py (a read-only verifier distinguishing CURRENT/DRIFTED/MISSING for every source path named by an immutable dispatch record, plus a --strict mode that exits non-zero on any non-CURRENT capsule) lives entirely under a9's owned workstreams/po03/strategy/ prefix, ships with workstreams/po03/tests/test_a9_source_capsule.py (6 tests), and this reviewer independently ran that exact test file (and the other three a9 test files) from a completely separate isolated clone: all 25 a9 tests passed under python3 -I -m unittest when this reviewer -- not a9 -- invoked them. This reviewer checked COMMISSION.md's 'Mandatory durable outputs' and 'Mandatory v001 receipts' lists (the only two enumerated authoritative output lists) and confirmed no source-capsule-drift verifier of this kind is already named there; MANIFEST.sha256 (a static hash receipt) is not the same mechanism as an active CURRENT/DRIFTED/MISSING checker with a strict enforcement mode. This is a9's own earlier a9-u01 finding (A-SOURCE-CAPSULE-CLOSURE) converted into working, tested tooling -- a legitimate reading of 'discoverable from the repository itself,' not a restatement of a founder- or commission-named item.
per_unit_disposition.boundary_a9_itself_documents: source_capsule.py is read-only and reporting-only (test_mechanism_probe_exposes_the_missing_closure_gate, per its own name, documents that no enforcement gate exists in control_plane.py itself); a9 does not claim otherwise. This reviewer's own a10-u03 audit independently confirms the same gap from the opposite direction: control_plane.py's ingest_result never checks immutable_input_manifest_sha256 against re-hashed current source bytes, only against the dispatch record's own frozen value (INV-5, HELD for manifest-copying, but silent on source-drift-after-dispatch, which is exactly the gap a9-u03's tool reports and does not itself close).

per_unit_disposition.notes: semantic_check.py runs standalone under workstreams/po03/strategy/, reports 7 findings (3 operator-taxonomy, 4 state-contract) with evidence, and this reviewer independently ran scripts/check_operator_taxonomy.py in two places: this reviewer's own worktree (before a9's change) and inside an isolated clone of a9's branch head (after a9's change). No fail_trigger observed.

cohort_level_rationale: Per criteria-a9.json's cohort_level_disposition_rule, ACCEPTED requires every unit to meet its pass_bar with artifacts this reviewer can independently inspect/run, and no reject_trigger observed. All four a9 units meet this bar under independent re-execution (not read-and-agree): a9-u01's evidence citations check out against real git blobs at the exact commits a9 measured; a9-u02's simulation reproduces byte-for-byte from real Wave A data when this reviewer runs it fresh; a9-u03 ships a genuine, non-duplicative, independently-testable discovery with its own passing test file; a9-u04's before/after taxonomy-gate claim holds exactly as stated. a9 also demonstrated the kind of self-correction the commission values: mid-review, a9 identified and fixed a real reproducibility hazard in its own test suite (tests that silently depended on the live, ever-changing working tree rather than a pinned commit) without prompting from any reviewer, which this reviewer independently confirmed by re-running the corrected suite from a clean isolated clone.
convergence_with_other_a10_units: a9-u01's A-SOURCE-CAPSULE-CLOSURE finding (path-ownership.json byte-drift after dispatch) is independently corroborated three separate ways in this review: (1) against the real git blob at a9's exact snapshot commit, (2) against this reviewer's own a10-u04 dispatch record which was frozen against the identical pre-drift hash, and (3) by discovering path-ownership.json has since drifted an additional, THIRD time beyond what a9 measured.

a9-u03's source_capsule.py documents (as a boundary, not a break) that there is no source-drift enforcement gate in control_plane.py; this reviewer's own a10-u03 adversarial audit of control_plane.py independently reaches the same conclusion from the opposite direction (INV-5's HELD result covers only manifest-copying between units, not source-byte drift after a single unit's own dispatch).
limitations: This disposition scores a9's four units as of commit 81ca1de. a9's branch is not immutable like PO-01; if a9 pushes further commits after this disposition is recorded, this reviewer's per-unit findings should be understood as pinned to 81ca1de, consistent with the pinned-SHA discipline this reviewer applied throughout a10-u01/u02/u04.
